title: Nobel Disease & Darwin Awards | Science vs Stupidity
description:
What are the Darwin Awards and the strange phenomenon called Nobel Disease? In this satirical but scientific episode of Pale Blue Thoughts, we explore two extremes of human behavior — people who die in absurd, self-inflicted ways (earning a Darwin Award), and brilliant Nobel Prize winners who later endorse pseudoscience and bizarre ideas.

We cover:
What the Darwin Awards are and why they highlight stupidity that “cleans the gene pool.”
Real-life Darwin Award stories — from stunts gone wrong to fatal lack of common sense.
The idea of Nobel Disease (Nobelitis) — when Nobel laureates drift into pseudoscience after their big win.
Famous cases: Luc Montagnier promoting COVID conspiracies and homeopathy, Linus Pauling with Vitamin C megadoses, Marie Curie supporting psychics, James Watson making racist claims, and even Einstein endorsing a psychic.
Indian examples like BM Hegde and other pseudoscience-promoting doctors.
Why science relies on the scientific method, peer review, and evidence, not the authority of individuals.

If you’ve searched for Darwin Awards explained, funny science awards, Nobel Disease, Nobel Prize pseudoscience, Luc Montagnier Covid, Linus Pauling Vitamin C, BM Hegde pseudoscience, this video gives you the scientific perspective.
